messages.content:
The new CRM export breaks csvtool. Values in it can contain double quotes, and the
exporter writes them the standard way, doubled inside a quoted field:

    C-1042,Grace Hopper,"Hopper & Sons, Ltd","Ships to ""Dock 4"" only",2026-10-12

csvtool json stops at the first row like that with
`csvtool: line 3: unexpected quote after the closing quote of field 4`. A cut-down copy
of the export is in examples/crm-export.csv.

Writing has the opposite problem: when csvtool csv writes a value that contains a double
quote, it puts the value in quotes but leaves the quote inside it as it is, so the CRM
import rejects the file.

Please fix both. A doubled quote inside a quoted field should be read as one double
quote in the value (in the library functions and in csvtool json), and when csvtool
writes CSV it should double every double quote inside a value it quotes. Rows that are
really broken, such as a double quote in the middle of an unquoted value, text after a
closing quote, or a quoted value that is never closed, should still be rejected with
their line number. Everything else about reading and writing CSV should keep working as
it does now.
